wiki.title: Ice Troll
wiki.text:
Ice Trolls are enemy NPCs that can be found in Snowhill. They are similar to regular trolls, only they are accustomed to cold weather. Due to this fact, they only live on terror mountain. Ice trolls are often the masters of frostfang snarlers and have been known to battle yetis. Currently, they are only found in battles with the exception of one named Gertrude who can be found south east of the Forest Troll Fort for unknown reasons.
